description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent class, which executes a shell command to measure and log the frame rate of the device during testing, including methods for calculating and writing average frame rate, and parsing command output.

classes.name: MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent
classes.description: A class that runs a shell command to measure frame rate, calculates average frame rate, and logs the result during testing.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frame rate given total frames and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Writes the calculated average frame rate to a log file on the SD card.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Parses the output string to extract the number of frames from the shell command output.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the shell command to get frame rate data, processes the output, and updates frame counts and timing.
